name: Frame Counter Free
description: Free, mobile-friendly frame tool: live frame/FPS HUD, per-click timing, macro recording and replay, and a window scan that measures how many frames each click could move.

hud.name: Show HUD
hud.description: Master switch for the on-screen counter. You can also toggle it from the pause menu.

show-frame.name: Frame counter
show-frame.description: Shows the current frame and the level time of this attempt.

show-fps.name: Display FPS
show-fps.description: Shows the FPS your device is actually rendering.

show-last-click.name: Last click
show-last-click.description: Shows the gap before the last press (time the button was up) or the hold of the last release, in frames and milliseconds.

show-counters.name: Counter rows
show-counters.description: One row per frame range, counting how many inputs landed in it during this attempt.

count-fps.name: Count at FPS
count-fps.description: Frame rate used to turn time into frames. At 60 or 120 a 4-frame gap at 240 becomes 1 or 2 frames. This does not change how the game runs.

counter-ranges.name: Counter ranges
counter-ranges.description: Comma-separated frames or ranges: 1,2,3,7-8,10+ (up to 12 rows). Frames are counted at 'Count at FPS'.

count-releases.name: Count releases too
count-releases.description: On: both presses and releases are counted (a release measures how long you held). Off: presses only.

input-display.name: Input display
input-display.description: Bottom centre: a square per player that lights up while the button is held.

sounds.name: Click sounds
sounds.description: Plays a ding on each counted press that is at most 'Sound up to' frames. Tighter clicks play lower.

export-csv.name: Export CSV on exit
export-csv.description: Writes every input of the session (attempt, time, frame, gap/hold) to a .csv in the mod's save folder when you leave the level or complete it.

record-macros.name: Record macros
record-macros.description: Saves your inputs as a macro every time you complete a level. Use the pause menu to Replay it or Scan windows.

show-popups.name: Window numbers
show-popups.description: During a replay of a scanned macro, shows each click's window in frames next to the icon.

scan-range.name: Scan range (steps)
scan-range.description: How many steps earlier and later each click is tried. Clicks with more room read 'N+'. Bigger = slower.

scan-horizon.name: Scan check length (s)
scan-horizon.description: A moved click passes if the icon is still alive this many seconds after it (or the level ends). Longer is stricter and slower.

scan-speed.name: Scan speed
scan-speed.description: Game speed multiplier while scanning. Lower it if your device stutters or the scan gives odd results.

show-hitboxes.name: Hitboxes
show-hitboxes.description: Draws the game's hitboxes while you play, record and watch a replay (never during a scan).

hitboxes-on-death.name: Hitboxes on death
hitboxes-on-death.description: Draws the hitboxes from the moment you die until the respawn.

record-speed.name: Recording speed
record-speed.description: The game runs this much slower while you play and record. Clicks land on the same steps as at full speed.

playback-speed.name: Replay speed
playback-speed.description: The visible replay runs this much slower (slow motion for videos).

save-incomplete.name: Keep incomplete runs
save-incomplete.description: When you die, the run is saved as a macro too (the furthest one is kept, a finished macro is never replaced by it) and measured up to where it ended.

scan-time-limit-minutes.name: Scan time limit (min)
scan-time-limit-minutes.description: Stop scanning after this many minutes and leave the rest unmeasured. 0 means no limit.

scan-resume.name: Continue previous scan
scan-resume.description: Clicks already measured are kept and skipped, so a scan can go on where it stopped. Clicks that read 'N+' are measured again when the range is larger now. Off: start from zero.

skip-useless.name: Leave out useless clicks
skip-useless.description: One extra replay per click without it. If the run still gets through, the click changes nothing: it gets no number and is not counted.

scan-part-from.name: Scan part: from (%)
scan-part-from.description: Only clicks from this percent of the level are measured. 0 with 100 below is the whole level.

scan-part-to.name: Scan part: to (%)
scan-part-to.description: Only clicks before this percent of the level are measured.

count-ship.name: Count straight fly
count-ship.description: Off: ship clicks that hold the ship level for several clicks in a row are left out (not measured, no number).

straight-fly-clicks.name: Straight fly from
straight-fly-clicks.description: How many ship clicks in a row (each under 0.25 s after the last) count as straight fly.

count-wave-spam.name: Count wave spam
count-wave-spam.description: Off: wave spam is left out (not measured, no number).

wave-spam-clicks.name: Wave spam from
wave-spam-clicks.description: How many wave clicks within about two blocks (0.19 s at normal speed) are wave spam.

nan-gd-settings.name: NaN GD settings
nan-gd-settings.description: Counts like NaN GD's videos: rows 9-10 down to 1, no straight fly and no wave spam. Overrides the related settings while on.

counter-colors.name: Counter colours
counter-colors.description: Colour per row by its first frame, as hex: 1:ff4c54,5:8df791. Empty for the defaults.

sound-1.name: Custom 1 frame sound
sound-1.description: Leave empty for the bundled ding. Pick a local audio file.

sound-2.name: Custom 2 frame sound
sound-2.description: Leave empty for the bundled ding. Pick a local audio file.

sound-3.name: Custom 3 frame sound
sound-3.description: Leave empty for the bundled ding. Pick a local audio file.

sound-4.name: Custom 4 frame sound
sound-4.description: Leave empty for the bundled ding. Pick a local audio file.

sound-5.name: Custom 5 frame sound
sound-5.description: Leave empty for the bundled ding. Pick a local audio file.

sound-6.name: Custom 6 frame sound
sound-6.description: Leave empty for the bundled ding. Pick a local audio file.

sound-7.name: Custom 7 frame sound
sound-7.description: Leave empty for the bundled ding. Pick a local audio file.

sound-8.name: Custom 8 frame sound
sound-8.description: Leave empty for the bundled ding. Pick a local audio file.

sound-9.name: Custom 9 frame sound
sound-9.description: Leave empty for the bundled ding. Pick a local audio file.

sound-wide.name: Custom wide sound
sound-wide.description: Plays for windows of 10 frames or more. Leave empty for the bundled ding.
